items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Were you in there the same time as Blind Freddy? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: It was afterwards that Blind Freddy came in.
Before Blind Freddy came in. I forgot about that Zulu parade. Whose band were you playing with the first time you ever?
